  • The total contributions for August were $3,168.38.

  • No public comment.

3.  24-55336  Recommendation to approve the Mayor’s Fund Standard operating procedures
  (SOP) for new applicants.

  • Member Rew submitted the SOP draft to staff for approval.
  • Members of the subcommittee and staff discussed the edits needed for the
  draft, additional verbiage will be added, exceptions to the standard criteria
  may be made under the following conditions:
  o Funds are designated specifically for direct client items rather than
  operational costs.
  o The requesting organization is seeking funds to support the launch of
  a new program.
  o Funds are an expansion of the same program.
  • Public comment added regarding the appreciation for the Mayor’s Fund.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Lewis, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Howat

5.  24-55338  Recommendation to discuss the notice for the Mayor’s Fund organization that will
  be featured in the press telegram.

  • Member Rew provided an update on the Press-Telegram article, outlining
  the necessary items required to complete the article and submit it for
  publication. Staff will send over organization options that will be highlighted
  in this article.
  • Public comment provided.

  A motion was made by Member Rew, seconded by Member Lewis, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Rew, Lewis
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Howat

6.  24-55339  Recommendation to discuss and approve the Mayor’s Fund Application Review-
  HIS LITTLE FEET INC.

  • Hali joined the meeting via Zoom, while Erin attended in person to provide an
  overview of His Little Feet. They shared details about the number of children
  the organization has helped over the past few years and highlighted other
  organizations they collaborate with.
  • They also emphasized that 100% of the funds they receive go directly toward
  purchasing shoes for children in need.
  • The staff is requesting the organization's Form 990 for review. The only other
  concern on the staff's end is whether we will proceed with funding this
  application, as this will be the third consecutive year that funding is being
  awarded.
  • Subcommittee members raised additional questions, which were addressed
  by Erin and Hali.
  • Member of the public joins the meeting and provides a brief introduction.
  • Subcommittee members and staff discussed the need to establish written
  policies and procedures for organizations that have received funding in the
  past and are continuing to apply.
